## What changes and why

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if any.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For UI changes, include a screenshot
using synthetic data. For archive changes, explain the effect on existing packages.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change follows the development discipline in AGENTS.md.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any user-facing or API changes.
- [ ] No real work orders, evidence, credentials, or local data are included.
